ops: Alerting policy applied. Pager on-call: @oncall

release-manager: If we need to rollback, revert to tag v3.6.1 and shift traffic back. Keep notes here.

tj: Patch deployed to canary, restarting pods. Monitoring.
raj: Canary recovered, error rate back to baseline. Proceeding to 100% traffic.
deploy-bot: Production cutover complete — finish_ts=5512346805 commit=9f3b2a2 tag=v3.6.2-release :rocket:
maria: Post-deploy: no SLO breaches. 95th latency +12ms, CPU spike normalized within 3m.
sasha: Thanks team — I'll add notes to the release doc and tag the rollback playbook link.
